thread.title: Wearables market could grow by 11% a year through 2022, says IDC - MarketWatch

author: Emily Bary
title: Wearables market could grow by 11% a year through 2022, says IDC - MarketWatch
text:
Research firm IDC on Monday predicted that wearables shipments could grow at an 11% annual clip through 2022, reaching 189.9 million devices shipped by then. IDC expects shipments to climb 8.5% in 2018. "The rise of smart wearables will not just be in mature markets, but also from emerging markets in Asia/Pacific and elsewhere," wrote Jitesh Ubrani, a senior research analyst at IDC. "Japan will play an equally important role as they consume more than one third of all smart wearables." IDC predicts that Apple Inc.'s AAPL, +0.22% WatchOS operating system will still be the market leader in 2022, though the firm sees its share dipping to 35.8% in 2022 from an expected 44.4% in 2018. Apple shares are up 1.3% in Monday trading, though they're down about 1% so far this year. The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -1.23% has slipped 2.8% in that time.
